text: I'm so frightened, I don't know if I'm overreacting. My granddaughter is 5, temp is 37.8. She has these little purple dots on her tummy and a couple of darker blotches on her legs and when I press the side of a glass on them they don't go away, I could still see them through it. I've done it three times now. Earlier she banged her head on the coffee table, cried straight away, and she's been totally herself since, playing and talking normally, so I don't think it's that. But the spots, I don't like them. Please can someone ring me back
